title: FM Transformation Global Business Analyst
description:
**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly analytical and collaborative
**FM Transformation Global Business Analyst**
to support the design and delivery of global Facilities Management (FM) transformation initiatives.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between business needs and technology solutions by translating complex operational requirements into clear, actionable deliverables. You will work closely with global stakeholders, Product teams, Process Owners, Technology teams, Data specialists, and Change leads to ensure solutions are aligned with business objectives and successfully adopted across the organization.

This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in large-scale business transformation, driving process standardization, operational efficiency, and technology-enabled change across multiple regions.

**What You'll Do**

**Business Analysis & Requirements Management**

* Lead discovery sessions, stakeholder interviews, workshops, and process analysis activities.
* Gather, analyze, prioritize, and validate business, functional, and non-functional requirements.
* Translate requirements into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, and supporting documentation.
* Maintain end-to-end traceability of requirements throughout the delivery lifecycle.

**Process Transformation**

* Document and analyze current-state and future-state processes.
* Identify process gaps, improvement opportunities, risks, and dependencies.
* Support the development and adoption of global standard processes while evaluating legitimate localization needs.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Partner with global, regional, and local stakeholders to align on requirements, priorities, and business outcomes.
* Facilitate discussions across cross-functional teams to resolve conflicts, clarify requirements, and drive decision-making.
* Build strong relationships with Product, Technology, Data, Change Management, and Deployment teams.

**Agile Delivery Support**

* Participate in backlog refinement, solution reviews, demonstrations, and sprint activities.
* Support Agile delivery teams by ensuring requirements remain clear, prioritized, and aligned with business objectives.
* Assist in managing requirement changes and assessing impacts on scope, processes, integrations, and deployment plans.

**Testing & Business Readiness**

* Define business scenarios, test cases, and acceptance criteria.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect triage, and business validation activities.
* Contribute to deployment readiness, training requirements, operational procedures, and transition-to-support planning.

**Governance & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain analysis artifacts, decisions, approvals, and documentation repositories.
* Support business case development, benefits realization, and transformation governance activities.
* Promote best practices, standards, templates, and continuous improvement across the FM Transformation organization.

**What You'll Bring**

**Experience**

* Proven experience as a Business Analyst within digital transformation, enterprise technology, or complex process improvement programs.
* Experience working in Agile environments using Scrum, Kanban, or similar methodologies.
* Demonstrated success supporting requirements management from discovery through deployment.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams and stakeholders preferred.

**Technical & Professional Skills**

* Strong expertise in:
* Requirements elicitation and management
* Process mapping and process improvement
* Gap analysis and impact assessment
* User stories and acceptance criteria development
* Requirements traceability and governance
* UAT and business acceptance processes
* Understanding of:
* Data quality, migration, and integration requirements
* Enterprise technology implementations
* Change management and operational readiness activities

**Tools**

Experience with one or more of:

* Azure DevOps
* Jira
* Microsoft Visio
* Microsoft Excel
* Microsoft PowerPoint
* Microsoft 365 Suite

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
* Certification in Business Analysis (IIBA, BCS, CBAP, CCBA or equivalent) preferred.
* Experience within Facilities Management (FM), CMMS, Asset Management, Work Order Management, Field Service, or Service Management platforms is advantageous.

**Key Competencies**

* Communicates Effectively
* Collaborates Across Boundaries
* Manages Ambiguity
* Business Insight
* Decision Quality
* Stakeholder Influencing
* Problem Solving
* Analytical Thinking
* Continuous Improvement Mindset

**Why Join Us?**

You'll be part of a global transformation team shaping the future of Facilities Management through process excellence, technology innovation, and operational transformation. You'll work with international stakeholders and have the opportunity to influence solutions that drive meaningful business impact at scale.

title: CRM Manager
description:
**Job Description: CRM Manager**

**Job Description:**

A CRM Specialist plays a crucial role within an organization’s marketing, sales, and

customer service teams by managing workflows and ensuring that customer relationships

are effectively maintained and enhanced through the use of Customer Relationship

Management (CRM) software. By leveraging technology and data, a CRM Specialist works

to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of customer-facing activities, ultimately

contributing to better customer experience and increased customer loyalty.

Rooted within the framework of customer-centric strategies, CRM Specialists are essential

in various industries where managing customer data, understanding customer behavior,

and automating outreach campaigns are critical for business success. These professionals

work at the intersection of technology and customer relations, synthesizing data insights to

drive business decisions and strategic planning.

**Responsibilities**

The main responsibilities of a CRM Specialist encompass a blend of technical, analytical,

and interpersonal skills. Here are the core tasks typically associated with this role:

CRM System Management: Maintain and update CRM systems, ensuring that all customer

information is accurate, complete, and up-to-date.

Data Analysis and Reporting: Analyze customer data to identify trends, behaviors, and

opportunities for targeted marketing campaigns or enhanced customer service strategies.

Generate reports to present findings to stakeholders.

Campaign Management: Develop, execute, and monitor marketing campaigns within the

CRM system, including email marketing, lead nurturing, and customer onboarding

campaigns.

Customer Segmentation: Create and manage customer segments based on behavioral,

demographic, and transactional data to personalize communication and marketing efforts.

Process Improvement: Identify and implement improvements to customer relationship

processes, enhancing operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

System Integration: Ensure the CRM integrates seamlessly with other systems such as

marketing automation tools, sales platforms, and customer service software.

User Training and Support: Provide training and ongoing support to team members using

the CRM system, ensuring they understand how to effectively leverage its tools and

capabilities.

Customer Feedback Management: Collect and analyze customer feedback, using insights

to make recommendations for service improvements and product enhancements.

Compliance and Data Security: Ensure customer data is handled in compliance with

relevant regulations and company policies, including GDPR and other data protection laws.

**Required skills**

A successful CRM Specialist needs a diverse set of skills, blending technical proficiency

with analytical and interpersonal abilities. Key skills include:

Technical Proficiency: Understanding of CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho

CRM) and proficiency in using these tools to manage customer data and workflows.

• Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze large datasets to extract actionable insights and

trends. Proficiency in using data analysis tools and techniques is crucial.

• Attention to Detail: Ensuring the accuracy and completeness of customer data, as

well as monitoring the effectiveness of campaigns and processes.

• Problem-Solving Abilities: Identifying issues within CRM processes and systems,

and developing effective solutions to address them.

• Excellent Communication Skills: Ability to communicate findings and recommendations clearly to various stakeholders, including technical and non-

technical team members.

• Project Management: Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage

multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely completion and implementation.

• Customer-Centric Mindset: Understanding customer needs and behaviors to

enhance customer engagement and satisfaction.

• Interpersonal Skills: Ability to work collaboratively within teams, provide training,

and support to CRM users across the organization.

• Adaptability: Staying informed about the latest CRM technologies and industry best

practices to continuously improve processes and tools.

**Tools and technologies**

CRM Specialists should be proficient in a variety of tools and technologies to

effectively manage customer relationships and data. Essential tools and

technologies include:

• CRM Platforms: Familiarity with major CRM systems like Salesforce, Microsoft

Dynamics 365, HubSpot, Zoho CRM, and Pipedrive.

• Marketing Automation Tools: Experience with tools such as Marketo, Pardot,

Mailchimp, and ActiveCampaign to automate marketing campaigns.

• Data Analysis Tools: Proficiency in using data analysis software like Google

Analytics, Tableau, Power BI, and Excel for data reporting and visualization.

• Email Marketing Software: Knowledge of tools like Mailchimp, SendGrid, and

Constant Contact for managing email marketing campaigns.

• Customer Feedback Tools: Experience with platforms like SurveyMonkey,

Qualtrics, and Zendesk for collecting and analyzing customer feedback.

• Integration Platforms: Understanding of tools like Zapier and MuleSoft that

facilitate the seamless integration of CRM systems with other business tools.

• Communication Tools: Proficiency in using communication and collaboration tools

like Slack, Microsoft Teams, and Zoom for effective team coordination and training.

• Project Management Software: Familiarity with tools like Asana, Trello, and

Monday.com to manage and track CRM-related projects.

title: Continuous Improvement Engineer
description:
Syensqo is all about chemistry. We’re not just referring to chemical reactions here, but also to the magic that occurs when the brightest minds get to work together. This is where our true strength lies. In you. In your future colleagues and in all your differences. And of course, in your ideas to improve lives while preserving our planet’s beauty for the generations to come.
  
**We are looking for:**

* A skilled Continual Improvement Engineer to drive process optimization and operational excellence across the organization and utilize methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, and other quality management tools to identify opportunities, implement improvements, and sustain best practices, supporting Syensqo mission of scientific exploration and breakthrough advancement.

**We count on you for:**

* Process Analysis & Optimization: Analyze current processes, identify inefficiencies, and recommend improvements to enhance productivity, quality, and safety.
* Project Management: Lead and support improvement projects from conception through implementation, ensuring timely delivery and measurable results.
* Data Collection & Analysis:Gather and analyze data to identify trends, root causes, and areas for improvement using statistical tools.
* Training & Coaching: Train and mentor employees on continuous improvement methodologies and best practices.
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with production, quality, engineering, and other teams to ensure alignment and successful implementation of improvement initiatives.
* Performance Monitoring: Develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of improvement activities.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate records of process changes, project progress, and outcomes.

**You can count on us for:**

* The chance to build a strong network across functions and manufacturing locations.
* Significant investment in your professional development to prepare you for future roles within the organization.
* An inclusive workplace culture that values and respects individual differences and backgrounds.

**You will bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, or related field (Master’s preferred)
* 3-7 years’ experience in process improvement, manufacturing, or quality engineering
* Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies (certification is a plus)
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Project management experience is an advantage
* Proficiency in data analysis tools (Minitab, Power BI)
* Results-oriented mindset
* Initiative and proactivity
* Teamwork and collaboration
* Adaptability and openness to change
* Attention to detai

**You will get:**

* Competitive salary package.
* 16 weeks of maternity, paternity, or co-parenting leave.
* Access to a comprehensive training platform.
* Complimentary well-being sessions (physical and psychological).

**Additional Information:**

* Location: Roha, Maharashtra

**About Us**

* Syensqo is a science company developing groundbreaking solutions that enhance the way we live, work, travel and play. Inspired by the scientific councils which Ernest Solvay initiated in 1911, we bring great minds together to push the limits of science and innovation for the benefit of our customers, with a diverse, global team of more than 13,000 associates. Our solutions contribute to safer, cleaner, and more sustainable products found in homes, food and consumer goods, planes, cars, batteries, smart devices and health care applications. Our innovation power enables us to deliver on the ambition of a circular economy and explore breakthrough technologies that advance humanity.
* At Syensqo, we seek to promote unity and not uniformity. We value the diversity that individuals bring and we invite you to consider a future with us, regardless of background, age, gender, national origin, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, ability or identity. We encourage individuals who may require any assistance or accommodations to let us know to ensure a seamless application experience. We are here to support you throughout the application journey and want to ensure all candidates are treated equally. If you are unsure whether you meet all the criteria or qualifications listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply.
